overview: The Medford School Committee received updates on Sandy Hook Promise safety programs, the literacy curriculum review, track equipment needs, and the FY24 budget process. The committee also adopted its goals for the year, approved a facility naming policy, and designated representatives for an upcoming DESE focus group.

items.title: Presentation on Sandy Hook Promise Programming
items.summary: Ms. Schulman presented an overview of district mental health and safety programming from Sandy Hook Promise, including the Say Something Anonymous Reporting System for grades 6–12.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent shared community announcements, student academic and athletic achievements, and upcoming district events.

items.title: Ethics Team Out-of-State Travel Request
items.summary: The committee approved a travel request for the high school ethics team to compete at the Ethics Bowl National Competition at the University of North Carolina.

items.title: Update on Literacy Core Program Review Process
items.summary: District administrators outlined the ongoing review process and timeline for selecting a new elementary core literacy program.

items.title: Report on Track and Field Athletic Needs and Equipment
items.summary: Dr. Peter Cushing presented an assessment and action plan addressing coaching additions, equipment replacements, facility repairs, and uniform sizing for the track and field program.

items.title: Report on FY24 Budget Process
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent presented an initial overview of the fiscal year 2024 budget process, strategic priorities, cost drivers, and proposed ESSER expenditure plans.

items.title: School Committee Goals for Remainder of Year
items.summary: The committee adopted five goals through November focusing on equity and translation, expanding fine arts, a Medford High School action plan, the superintendent evaluation, and the MSBA application.

items.title: Second Reading of Policy for Dedication and Naming of School Facilities
items.summary: The committee approved the second reading of a policy establishing formal guidelines and procedures for naming district buildings, facilities, and grounds.

items.title: Resolution on Student Participation in Regular Meetings
items.summary: Referred a proposal regarding student presentation agenda items to the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion subcommittee for further review.

items.title: Selection of Representatives for DESE District Review Focus Group
items.summary: Designated Member McLaughlin, Member Graham, and Mayor Lungo-Koehn to represent the committee in the DESE district review focus group in April 2023.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of Robert L. Maloney Sr., Rosetta DeVita, and Paul Howard.
